verdict.rationale: Algolia documents Rules that override relevance and let you reposition products in results, plus Merchandising Studio visual tools for curating, pinning, and boosting. Synonym management appears only as a CLI agent-skill line, and nothing documents hiding specific hits. missing for 10: explicit evidence of hiding/demoting hits for a query, first-party synonym documentation beyond a one-line CLI skill mention, query-condition specifics for rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define synonyms and curate results — pin, boost, or hide specific hits for specific queries

citations.quote: If one of your products isn’t appearing where you want it to in your search results, you can reposition it. Rules let you make precise and (if desired) temporary modifications to your search results.
Visual tools for curating, pinning, and boosting search results
